blocks.text: Shipyard specialties and what each hits hardest.
A variant costs its generalist's price plus a fee per gun (see Combat > Weapon Mods), and its chevrons and shots wear its color.
No weak matchup: never far behind against any target. Against starbases every variant does better, and a Disruptor does best.
blocks.title: Generalist

blocks.text: Fleets heavy on cruisers and carriers. Against any warship it is never far worse than a generalist.
blocks.title: Pulsar

blocks.text: Destroyers: by the layer math, nothing beats it against them.
blocks.title: Breacher

blocks.text: Corvette swarms, and bombarding worlds: it hits population hardest.
blocks.title: Ravager

blocks.text: Carriers and starbases: strongest against both. Weak against corvettes, where it needs more damage than a generalist.
blocks.title: Disruptor

blocks.text: Cruisers and carriers, cruisers above all. No gain against corvettes or destroyers.
blocks.title: Inhibitor

blocks.text: A variant keeps its class's hull; only its chevrons change color, matching its shots (generalists wear yellow).
How much base damage it takes to destroy each target, and lower kills faster. This is layer math, not battle results; Combat > Matchups has the measured duels.
A ship's variant is chosen at the Shipyard (Variants research), and it stacks with the ship's mark (Ships > Marks).
